about: The accepted coverage of the quick parity mode (lane H4): every item a quick run must have, whatever the harness that runs it says. parity_compare.py reads this file from the accepted ref (perf/first-principles, or --accepted-ref), never from the candidate's checkout, and requires each base item it names; parity_cli.py, parity_lsp.py, parity_fuzz.py (through parity.sh) and parity_tests.py run at least these items in quick mode. Removing an entry is a reviewed change of this file: until it is accepted, compare still requires the item and prints the shrink. cli: item names; lsp: session names (every answer of the session); fuzz: cases 0 to count-1 of the seed; tests: every test of a binary whose name starts with one of binaryPrefixes, and every TestLocal row when testLocal. Version 2 (lane H7) adds "api": the api scenarios a quick run must have (parity-api-scenarios.json).
